name: Satoyama Development Mechanism Call for Proposals

funder.name: Satoyama Development Mechanism (IGES, secretariat of the International Partnership for the Satoyama Initiative)

summary: Seed grants of up to JPY 2.2 million for up to 24 months, for IPSI member organisations to develop or carry out collaborative activities that address the Satoyama Initiative's landscape and biodiversity objectives.
reporting: Recipients must submit a final project evaluation report at the project end, and are recommended to update the secretariat on major progress.

eligibility.rule: Is an approved IPSI member at the date of proposal submission
Agrees to act as the SDM focal point for a jointly implemented project
Demonstrates sufficient institutional capability to implement the project
Demonstrates sufficient English proficiency to deliver a good report
Is not a member of the SDM Advisory Group or Executive Board
Does not have an ongoing SDM project at the application date

documents: Project-site photographs, up to five, with captions
Project site map showing location and size

status.quote: Deadline of applications: 14 August 2026 Extended until 21 August 2026 (closed)

deadline.quote: Deadline of applications: 14 August 2026 Extended until 21 August 2026 (closed)

access.quote: IPSI members are kindly invited to submit project proposals through the Online Application at the bottom of this page

window.quote: Deadline of applications: 14 August 2026 Extended until 21 August 2026 (closed)

amount.quote: Grant amount per project: up to JPY 2,200,000

reporting.quote: The SDM mandates the grant recipients to submit the final project evaluation report at the project end.

effort.quote: Interested and eligible IPSI members (see section 6.1 Eligibility criteria) are invited to submit project proposals in accordance with the application guidelines
The SDM follows a three-step process for project selection, eligibility check, screening and prioritisation based on the respective three criteria sets

eligibility.quote: The applicant is an approved member of the IPSI at the date of submission of the project proposal.
The applicant has agreed to act as focal point of the proposed project to be contacted by the SDM Secretariat, if the proposed project is to be jointly implemented by more than one IPSI members.
The applicant has demonstrated sufficient institutional capability to implement the proposed project.
The applicant has demonstrated sufficient English proficiency to deliver a good project report.
The applicant is not a member of either the Advisory Group or the Executive Board of SDM.
The applicant does NOT have an ongoing SDM project as of the application date.

after_award.quote: grant recipients must submit a project final evaluation report to the SDM Secretariat through the designated online form on the SDM Website.

documents.quote: Up to five photographs of project site (e.g. landscape or seascapes, wildlife, local people, activities) in JPEG or JPG format, with captions of photos in a word document;
Project site map (location and size) preferably with the project site boundaries demarcated on Google My Maps
